end.summary:
Discussed what giraffes, deer, and tigers eat.
Manav said giraffes eat leaves from trees using their long necks.
Built and read food chains: grass → deer → tiger and algae → larvae → fish.
Used arrows correctly in all three food-chain attempts.
Teach-back was not passed; animal food-group answers needed more practice.
end.parentNote: Asha practised plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both, along with building food chains using arrows. Manav explained the giraffe’s long neck and correctly arranged food chains such as grass → deer → tiger. There was a mix-up when “tiger” was answered with “grass”; it was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Manav to sort a few animals by what they eat and make one arrow food chain.
